assets.name: warehouse

Recreate only a premium, clean, highly detailed 3D miniature warehouse cutaway: natural white warehouse walls and floor slab, cyan steel pallet racks, many natural brown cardboard cartons, white semi trucks with cyan trailers at loading docks, small forklifts and a few green trees. Panoramic 3/4 isometric view, broad horizontal warehouse composition, entire scene completely contained with generous clear margins on all sides. Subject occupies a wide low silhouette, about 2.5:1. No global blue tint or color overlay; whites stay white, cartons brown. No text, logos, UI or watermark anywhere.
